description: NaMg₁₄BO₁₆ is Caswellsilverite-derived structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (2.15 Å) and four longer (2.27 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent BO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.48 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.16 Å. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.16 Å. In the fourth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent BO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-16°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.18 Å. In the fifth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.16 Å. In the sixth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one BO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-20°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.15 Å. B is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted BO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent BO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (1.74 Å) and two longer (2.15 Å) B-O bond lengths. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with six ONaMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₅B octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. There is one shorter (1.95 Å) and two longer (2.16 Å) O-Mg bond lengths. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Mg and one B atom to form distorted OMg₅B octahedra that share corners with six ONaMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₅B octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-16°. Both O-Mg bond lengths are 2.17 Å. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Mg and one B atom to form distorted OMg₅B octahedra that share corners with six ONaMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₅B octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-16°. There are two shorter (2.14 Å) and two longer (2.17 Å) O-Mg bond lengths. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent OMg₆ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-3°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Mg atoms to form ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₅B octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to four equivalent Mg and two equivalent B atoms to form OMg₄B₂ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₅B octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₅B octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. Both O-Mg bond lengths are 2.11 Å. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to five Mg and one B atom to form distorted OMg₅B octahedra that share corners with six OMg₅B octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-16°. The O-Mg bond length is 2.48 Å.
